$comment: A-share price limit rules by board and ST status — single source of truth for both TS and Python. Main board 10%, ChiNext/STAR 20%, BSE 30%; ST instruments are capped at 5% on every board. Limit-up/down must be derived from these per-day rules, never a fixed percentage.

tickAdjustment.$comment: Per-exchange tick size and minimum one-tick adjustment rules. SSE 交易规则 3.3.11 (tick 0.01) / 3.3.17 (差<一个申报价格最小变动单位时，以前收盘价加/减一个最小变动单位为涨/跌幅价格); SZSE 交易规则 3.3.11 (tick 0.01) / 3.3.19 (同上，且价格下限为一个最小变动单位); BSE 交易规则 (tick 0.01, 30% 涨跌幅, 同构最小变动单位取整). Three exchanges all use tick 0.01 and equivalent minimum-one-tick adjustment; SZSE additionally enforces a price floor of one tick. Rules are stated explicitly per exchange, never inferred.

BSE.source: BSE Trading Rules (tick 0.01, 30% band, tick rounding)
